WITH order_totals AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) AS order_date,
    SUM(p.payment_value) AS order_value
  FROM orders.orders o
  JOIN payments.order_payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
  GROUP BY o.order_id, CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)
),
window_stats AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(order_value) AS value,
    COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM order_totals
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2017-08-01' AND order_date < DATE '2017-09-01'
),
baseline_stats AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(order_value) AS baseline,
    COUNT(*) AS n_baseline
  FROM order_totals
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2017-07-01' AND order_date < DATE '2017-08-01'
),
baseline_periods AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) AS period_start,
    AVG(order_value) AS period_value
  FROM order_totals
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2017-07-01' AND order_date < DATE '2017-08-01'
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date)
),
spread_calc AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) >= 2 THEN STDDEV(period_value) ELSE NULL END AS spread
  FROM baseline_periods
)
SELECT
  ROUND(w.value, 4) AS value,
  ROUND(b.baseline, 4) AS baseline,
  ROUND(s.spread, 4) AS spread,
  w.n AS n,
  b.n_baseline AS n_baseline
FROM window_stats w, baseline_stats b, spread_calc s;
